capabilities: Run Pomodoro sessions with adjustable work/rest ratios
Browse, create, complete, and reorder Todoist tasks in Obsidian
Group tasks by project and link them to notes
Show due-date, subtask-count, and time bubbles on task rows
Log sessions and workouts on year and month heatmaps
extras: No telemetry; token, settings, sessions, workouts, and history are stored in the plugin folder, with additive data reconciled across devices via synced settings. Also installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Pomodoro timer, no Todoist task access, and no visual record of time worked.

relations.evidence: Browse, create, select, and complete Todoist tasks without leaving Obsidian.

summary: Pomodoro timer that pulls Todoist tasks into Obsidian and logs sessions on contribution heatmaps.
